_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-78a, first rung of the ladder. The overlay ships minSeverity: warning, so info findings must be filtered out — a config-driven filter. But minSeverity runs before warnings are demoted to info (reviewer.ts:2029, :2065), so a demoted warning can still render as info: `info: 0` holds only for some model outputs, and this fixture is labelled `model` (mergewatch.ai#660). maxFindings: 3 caps the POSTED set, asserted via inline comments. That half became code-enforced when mergewatch.ai#569 shipped `capFindings()`, which enforces the cap in code after the filter chain; before it, maxFindings was only interpolated into the orchestrator prompt, so the assertion was a hard cap against a soft request and failed whenever the model returned more (fixtures#2049). The cap exempts custom-agent findings; this overlay defines none, so it is a hard cap here. that the survivors are the top-RANKED (criticals defined last in the file on purpose) needs a diff against the unfiltered run and stays manual, as do the remaining rungs.
_variance: minSeverity filters before warnings are demoted to info (reviewer.ts:2029, :2065), so a demoted warning can render as info; info: 0 holds only for some outputs.
